answer: A bond must be split across 4 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Because each haven escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the meadow ledger records every share and the inlet audit shows the split. Assembling that for 132 aliases means 132 times 4 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 28 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
